jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Ribterra production game art, match the supplied original game concept as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Detailed painterly pre-rendered medieval miniature craftsmanship, realistic materials and readable silhouettes, honey oak timber, cream plaster, cool blue-grey slate shingles and dressed stone, restrained royal-blue cloth and gold emblems, amber windows. Orthographic isometric camera, 2:1 ground diagonals, front and right facades, verticals vertical, upper-left light. No cartoon outlines, no flat vector art, no low-poly. SPRITE DELIVERY: isolated artwork on ACTUAL transparent RGBA alpha background. NEVER paint checkerboard squares. If transparent output is impossible, use a perfectly uniform solid dark navy #08121E backdrop; absolutely no checkerboard. No gradient or ground plane. No cast shadow onto background. Keep each object completely inside its own equal grid cell with at least 8% empty margin. No grid lines, labels, letters, numbers, title or watermark. Exactly 5 equal columns. Within EACH ROW preserve exactly the SAME building footprint, camera, scale, architectural details and base anchor. Columns from left to right: (1) foundation, supplies, low stone courses; (2) timber frame and half-built walls, scaffold; (3) complete walls and rafters, half-tiled roof, scaffold; (4) completed summer building, no scaffolding; (5) exactly that finished building with accumulated snow on roof and ledges, amber windows. Anchor ground center at cell-local (50%,88%). Landscape sheet 2500x2000, FOUR rows. Row 1 two-storey half-timber HOUSE with small porch, chimney and blue banner; row 2 founding CAMP with royal-blue pavilion, supplies and stone firepit; row 3 FARM with one-storey farm cottage and attached compact fenced wheat patch; row 4 STOCKPILE open-front timber shed with slate roof, neat log piles, blocks and sacks. Exactly 20 sprites. Rich reference detail.
